items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Well, I think I made about $55,000 with Jimmy Ryan in five months.

ctx.x: Yeah, on some of that, the cheek labels.

And then I still went back. I was down at Nick's. In and out, in and out, in and out. So, uh, then I leave there. After I leave the Mills Cavalcade, uh, I went to Jimmy Ryan's for five and a half months. Did a terrific job there, thank God. And then, uh, I went down to Connors, and Connors was a little bit under the red side. And Pete Pesky asked me if I'd go to work for him. And I says, well, he says, you did a good job up at Ryan's, I hear. Well, I think I made about $55,000 with Jimmy Ryan in five months. It's…
Is this the new Condon's over there on?
